facts.business: Bindal Exports Limited is a manufacturer and exporter of fabrics, made-ups, and home textiles.

auditor.name: Rajesh Bhauwala & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) absence of actuarial valuation for gratuity liability, (b) no provision for leave salary on accrual basis, (c) no provision for bonus on accrual basis. Key audit matters include balances with statutory authorities of Rs. 6.78 lacs, non-provision for gratuity/bonus/leave encashment, and trade receivables with non-moving balances lacking confirmation.

key_risks: Uncertainty in gratuity liability due to lack of actuarial valuation
Non-provision for leave salary and bonus on accrual basis
Trade receivables with non-moving balances lacking confirmation
Balances with statutory authorities (GST/VAT/Excise/Service Tax) aggregating Rs. 6.78 lacs subject to assessment
facts.related_party_note: No non-cash transactions with directors or connected persons entered into during the year.
